verses.zh: 以斯拉祷告，认罪，哭泣，俯伏在　神殿前的时候，有以色列中的男女孩童聚集到以斯拉那里，成了大会，众民无不痛哭。
verses.en: While Ezra was praying and confessing, weeping and throwing himself to the ground before the temple of God, a very large crowd of Israelites—men, women, and children alike—gathered around him. The people wept loudly.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “with much weeping.”

verses.zh: 属以拦的子孙、耶歇的儿子示迦尼对以斯拉说：「我们在此地娶了外邦女子为妻，干犯了我们的　神，然而以色列人还有指望。
verses.en: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, from the descendants of Elam,[NOTE:1] addressed Ezra: “We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying[NOTE:2] foreign women from the local peoples.[NOTE:3] Nonetheless, there is still hope for Israel in this regard.[NOTE:4]
notes: The translation reads with the Qere, many medieval Hebrew MSS, the LXX, the Syriac Peshitta, and Vulgate עֵילָם (ʿelam, “Elam”) rather than the reading עוֹלָם (ʿolam, “eternity”) found in the MT.
Heb “in that we have given a dwelling to.” So also in vv. 14, 17, 18.
Heb “the peoples of the lands.”
Heb “upon this.”

verses.zh: 现在当与我们的　神立约，休这一切的妻，离绝她们所生的，照着我主和那因　神命令战兢之人所议定的，按律法而行。
verses.en: Therefore let us enact[NOTE:1] a covenant with our God to send away all these women and their offspring, in keeping with your counsel, my lord,[NOTE:2] and that of those who respect[NOTE:3] the commandments of our God. And let it be done according to the law.
notes: Heb “cut.”

The MT vocalizes this word as a plural, which could be understood as a reference to God, but the context seems to suggest that a human lord is intended. The apparatus of BHS suggests repointing the word as a singular (“my lord”), but this is unnecessary. The plural (“my lords”) can be understood in an honorific sense even when a human being is in view. Most English versions regard this as a reference to Ezra, so the present translation supplies “your” before “counsel” to make this clear.
Heb “who tremble at”; NAB, NIV “who fear.”

verses.zh: 你起来，这是你当办的事，我们必帮助你，你当奋勉而行。」
verses.en: Get up, for this matter concerns you. We are with you, so be strong and act decisively!”

verses.zh: 以斯拉便起来，使祭司长和利未人，并以色列众人起誓说，必照这话去行；他们就起了誓。
verses.en: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests and Levites and all Israel take an oath to carry out this plan.[NOTE:1] And they all took a solemn oath.
notes: Heb “to do according to this plan.”

verses.zh: 以斯拉从　神殿前起来，进入以利亚实的儿子约哈难的屋里，到了那里不吃饭，也不喝水；因为被掳归回之人所犯的罪，心里悲伤。
verses.en: Then Ezra got up from in front of the temple of God and went to the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. While he stayed[NOTE:1] there, he did not eat food or drink water, for he was in mourning over the infidelity of the exiles.
notes: The translation reads וַיָּלֶן (vayyalen, “and he stayed”) rather than the reading וַיֵּלֶךְ (vayyelekh, “and he went”) of the MT. Cf. the LXX.

verses.zh: 他们通告犹大和耶路撒冷被掳归回的人，叫他们在耶路撒冷聚集。
verses.en: A proclamation[NOTE:1] was circulated[NOTE:2] throughout Judah and Jerusalem[NOTE:3] that all the exiles were to be assembled in Jerusalem.
notes: Heb “voice.”
Heb “they sent.”
For location see Map5-B1; Map6-F3; Map7-E2; Map8-F2; Map10-B3; JP1-F4; JP2-F4; JP3-F4; JP4-F4.

verses.zh: 凡不遵首领和长老所议定、三日之内不来的，就必抄他的家，使他离开被掳归回之人的会。
verses.en: Everyone who did not come within three days would thereby forfeit all his property, in keeping with the counsel of the officials and the elders. Furthermore, he himself would be excluded from the assembly of the exiles.

verses.zh: 于是，犹大和便雅悯众人，三日之内都聚集在耶路撒冷。那日正是九月二十日，众人都坐在　神殿前的宽阔处；因这事，又因下大雨，就都战兢。
verses.en: All the men of Judah and Benjamin were gathered in Jerusalem within the three days. (It was in the ninth month, on the twentieth day of that month.) All the people sat in the square at the temple of God, trembling because of this matter and because of the rains.

verses.zh: 祭司以斯拉站起来，对他们说：「你们有罪了；因你们娶了外邦的女子为妻，增添以色列人的罪恶。
verses.en: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have behaved in an unfaithful manner by taking foreign wives! This has contributed to the guilt of Israel.

verses.zh: 现在当向耶和华―你们列祖的　神认罪，遵行他的旨意，离绝这些国的民和外邦的女子。」
verses.en: Now give praise to the Lord God of your fathers, and do his will. Separate yourselves from the local residents[NOTE:1] and from these foreign wives.”
notes: Heb “the peoples of the land.”

verses.zh: 会众都大声回答说：「我们必照着你的话行，
verses.en: All the assembly replied in a loud voice: “We will do just as you have said![NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “thus according to your word [singular = Qere] concerning us, to do.”

verses.zh: 只是百姓众多，又逢大雨的时令，我们不能站在外头，这也不是一两天办完的事，因我们在这事上犯了大罪；
verses.en: However, the people are numerous and it is the rainy season.[NOTE:1] We are unable to stand here outside. Furthermore, this business cannot be resolved in a day or two, for we have sinned greatly in this matter.
notes: Heb “the time [is] rain showers.”

verses.zh: 不如为全会众派首领办理。凡我们城邑中娶外邦女子为妻的，当按所定的日期，同着本城的长老和士师而来，直到办完这事，　神的烈怒就转离我们了。」
verses.en: Let our leaders take steps[NOTE:1] on behalf of all the assembly. Let all those in our towns who have married foreign women come at an appointed time, and with them the elders of each town and its judges, until the hot anger of our God is turned away from us in this matter.”
notes: Heb “stand.”

verses.zh: 惟有亚撒黑的儿子约拿单，特瓦的儿子雅哈谢阻挡（或译：总办）这事，并有米书兰和利未人沙比太帮助他们。
verses.en: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were[NOTE:1] against this, assisted by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite.
notes: Heb “stood.”

verses.zh: 被掳归回的人如此而行。祭司以斯拉和些族长按着宗族都指名见派；在十月初一日，一同在座查办这事，
verses.en: So the exiles proceeded accordingly. Ezra the priest separated out[NOTE:1] by name men who were leaders in their family groups.[NOTE:2] They sat down to consider this matter on the first day of the tenth month,
notes: The translation reads the Hiphil singular וַיַּבְדֵּל לוֹ (vayyavdel lo, “separated for himself”) rather than the Niphal plural וַיִּבָּדְלוּ (vayyibbadelu, “were separated”) of the MT.
Heb “the heads of the fathers, to the house of their fathers, and all of them by name.”

verses.zh: 到正月初一日，才查清娶外邦女子的人数。
verses.en: and on the first day of the first month they finished considering all the men who had married foreign wives.

verses.zh: 在祭司中查出娶外邦女子为妻的，就是耶书亚的子孙约萨达的儿子，和他弟兄玛西雅、以利以谢、雅立、基大利；
verses.en: It was determined[NOTE:1] that from the descendants of the priests, the following had taken foreign wives: from the descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
notes: Heb “found.”

verses.zh: 他们便应许必休他们的妻。他们因有罪，就献群中的一只公绵羊赎罪。
verses.en: (They gave their word[NOTE:1] to send away their wives; their guilt offering was a ram from the flock for their guilt.)
notes: Heb “hand.”

verses.zh: 音麦的子孙中，有哈拿尼、西巴第雅。
verses.en: From the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

verses.zh: 哈琳的子孙中，有玛西雅、以利雅、示玛雅、耶歇、乌西雅。
verses.en: From the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

verses.zh: 巴施户珥的子孙中，有以利约乃、玛西雅、以实玛利、拿坦业、约撒拔、以利亚撒。
verses.en: From the descendants of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

verses.zh: 利未人中，有约撒拔、示每、基拉雅（基拉雅就是基利他），还有毗他希雅、犹大、以利以谢。
verses.en: From the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also known as Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

verses.zh: 歌唱的人中有以利亚实。守门的人中，有沙龙、提联、乌利。
verses.en: From the singers: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

verses.zh: 以色列人巴录的子孙中，有拉米、耶西雅、玛基雅、米雅民、以利亚撒、玛基雅、比拿雅。
verses.en: From the Israelites: from the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkijah, and Benaiah.

verses.zh: 以拦的子孙中，有玛他尼、撒迦利亚、耶歇、押底、耶利末、以利雅。
verses.en: From the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

verses.zh: 萨土的子孙中，有以利约乃、以利亚实、玛他尼、耶利末、撒拔、亚西撒。
verses.en: From the descendants of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

verses.zh: 比拜的子孙中，有约哈难、哈拿尼雅、萨拜、亚勒。
verses.en: From the descendants of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

verses.zh: 巴尼的子孙中，有米书兰、玛鹿、亚大雅、雅述、示押、耶利末。
verses.en: From the descendants of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

verses.zh: 巴哈・摩押的子孙中，有阿底拿、基拉、比拿雅、玛西雅、玛他尼、比撒列、宾内、玛拿西。
verses.en: From the descendants of Pahath Moab: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

verses.zh: 哈琳的子孙中，有以利以谢、伊示雅、玛基雅、示玛雅、西缅、
verses.en: From[NOTE:1] the descendants of Harim: Eliezer, Ishijah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
notes: The translation reads with many medieval Hebrew MSS and ancient versions וּמִבְּנֵי (umibbene, “and from the sons of”) rather than the reading וּבְנֵי (uvene, “and the sons of”) found in the MT.

verses.zh: 便雅悯、玛鹿、示玛利雅。
verses.en: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

verses.zh: 哈顺的子孙中，有玛特乃、玛达他、撒拔、以利法列、耶利买、玛拿西、示每。
verses.en: From the descendants of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

verses.zh: 巴尼的子孙中，有玛玳、暗兰、乌益、
verses.en: From the descendants of Bani:[NOTE:1] Maadai, Amram, Uel,
notes: The name “Bani” appears in both v. 29 and v. 34. One of these names has probably undergone alteration in the transmission process, but it is not clear exactly where the problem lies or how it should be corrected.

verses.zh: 比拿雅、比底雅、基禄、
verses.en: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Keluhi,

verses.zh: 瓦尼雅、米利末、以利亚实、
verses.en: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

verses.zh: 玛他尼、玛特乃、雅扫、
verses.en: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu.

verses.zh: 巴尼、宾内、示每、
verses.en: From[NOTE:1] the descendants of Binnui: Shimei,
notes: The translation reads וּמִבְּנֵי בִנּוּי (umibbene vinnuy, “and from the sons of Binnui”) rather than the reading וּבָנִי וּבִנּוּי (uvani uvinnuy, “and Bani and Binnui”) of the MT.

verses.zh: 示利米雅、拿单、亚大雅、
verses.en: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

verses.zh: 玛拿底拜、沙赛、沙赖、
verses.en: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

verses.zh: 亚萨利、示利米雅、示玛利雅、
verses.en: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

verses.zh: 沙龙、亚玛利雅、约瑟。
verses.en: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

verses.zh: 尼波的子孙中，有耶利、玛他提雅、撒拔、西比拿、雅玳、约珥、比拿雅。
verses.en: From the descendants of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.

verses.zh: 这些人都娶了外邦女子为妻，其中也有生了儿女的。
verses.en: All these had taken foreign wives, and some of them also had children by these women.[NOTE:1]
notes: The final statement in v. 44 is difficult in terms of both its syntax and its meaning. The present translation attempts to make sense of the MT. But the passage may have undergone textual variation in the transmission process. One proposal is that the text should be emended to read “and they sent these wives and children away” (cf. NAB, NRSV, TEV, CEV).
